rawContent: Rape Crisis Center hosted founder of the #metoo campaign, Tarana Burke, last month. Joined by the @PeeDeeCoalition, this incredible event marks a special time in history for our member orgs & the movement as a whole. We're working to change culture. We are stronger together! https://t.co/aGihTtciLK

Dr. Ekue facilitated a convo around the article "Russell Simmons, R. Kelly & Why Black Women Can’t Say #MeToo" with @PDCoalition​. They also discussed how the 7 principles of Kwanza could serve as a foundation for communities of color to focus on positive cultural practices. https://t.co/hsnQobkciX

#METOO, NOW WHAT? takes the discussion to another level, engaging women & men from all generations in dialogue about these difficult issues. The series seeks to answer: How did we get here & how can we use this moment to effect positive and lasting change? https://t.co/W0sFyIwfXd

In the wake of #MeToo, many folks have been asking what they can do. We're calling on YOU to declare what you #CanDo. We want to start a conversation about things we can do to respond to and prevent sexual violence, support survivors and change culture.
